meta.name: Birangana
meta.description: Panic grips the city as a ruthless predator targets social media influencers in a wave of terrifying attacks. Inspector Chitra Basu leads a high-stakes manhunt to dismantle a dangerous scheme of control. The ultimate shock strikes when she unmasks the mastermind behind it all.

videos.title: Dariye Dekhchi Sheshta
videos.overview: Sub-inspector Chitra Basu suspects murder in a bride's death, but senior officers insist it's just a case of suicide.

videos.title: Swapner Lash
videos.overview: Chitra is suspended while probing the case, but another bride's death in the same manner raises new doubts.

videos.title: Rawkte Mangshe
videos.overview: A special team is formed to catch the serial killer, and Chitra is brought back to join the investigation.

videos.title: Jhorer Shobdo
videos.overview: Chitra crosses paths with Chirayu at a wedding. She soon suspects similar murders are happening in other religions.

videos.title: Chhadmabesi
videos.overview: As Chitra and her husband are attacked, the murderer manages to escape before being caught.

videos.title: Lukono Aghat
videos.overview: The police link Chirayu to the murders, but there's no evidence. Their search leads to an old woman instead.

videos.title: Pichhu Daak
videos.overview: In the final showdown, Chitra sets a trap for the real killer, risking her sister's life in the process.

videos.title: Nakkata
videos.overview: Inspector Chitra follows a cryptic trail of clues that raises more questions than answers, as Pritha's case deepens.

videos.title: Ekei Noksha
videos.overview: What seemed like an isolated case shifts when Chitra Basu uncovers a chilling link to a new serial killer.

videos.title: Guptodorshok
videos.overview: Clues hidden among beauty influencers draw Chitra into a web where fame and online hate conceal a secret.

videos.title: Khuner Khoje Khuni
videos.overview: An unsuspected arrest brings down the world of Chitra, as she discovers the people close to her, are the most dangerous.

videos.title: Deri Hoye Gelo
videos.overview: Chitra's world shatters as Dheer tracks the killer toward an explosive confrontation no one sees coming.

videos.title: Rokter Hisheb
videos.overview: The high-stakes chase reaches its breaking point when Chitra comes face to face with the prime suspect.

videos.title: Shesh Khela
videos.overview: With the case on the verge of collapsing, Gobindo escapes and forces Chitra into a final fight for justice.
